newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Resolute sets three cent final div.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Resolute sets three cent final div.

text.p: Gold miner and explorer Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Tuesday it had declared a final dividend of three cents per share, bringing total dividends for the year to June 30, 1996 to six cents per share.
Resolute Samantha did not declare a final dividend when it released its final year results on September 12.
The three cent final dividend is unchanged from the previous year and the six cent total dividend is also unchanged.

"The directors have maintained the final dividend at this level in order to retain adequate cash to fund the company's current substantial gold development and exploration programmes," Resolute Samantha said.
